personal.name: Arpit Deosthale
personal.tagline: AI-native engineer building ML systems, full-stack products, and IoT devices.
personal.bio: Computer Engineering student at Dr. D.Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pune (2023–2027). I build end-to-end ML systems — from a radar-based human detection model that made the Smart India Hackathon Finals, to facial-recognition attendance systems, to IoT sensor fusion on bare ESP32. I compete in 20+ hackathons and CTFs and ship fast under ambiguity.

featuredProjects.title: VITAL Radar
featuredProjects.subtitle: ML-Based Human Detection System — SIH Finalist
featuredProjects.description: Owned the full product lifecycle end-to-end: problem framing, model training, real-time inference, and live demo. Selected for Smart India Hackathon Finals from thousands of entries. Trained and deployed ML classification models on Raspberry Pi behind a Flask REST backend for reliable real-time radar-based human detection under real-world conditions, with Firebase integration for remote monitoring.

featuredProjects.title: Wahan Mitra
featuredProjects.subtitle: Intelligent IoT Headlamp Automation
featuredProjects.description: Self-initiated IoT system on ESP32 with multi-sensor fusion (IR, ultrasonic, LDR) to solve a real low-visibility driving problem from scratch. Implements real-time environment classification and automated beam-switching logic — embedded AI and sensor-driven inference with no reference template. Patent filed.

featuredProjects.title: AutoAttend
featuredProjects.subtitle: AI-Powered Facial Recognition Attendance
featuredProjects.description: Team-based, facial-recognition attendance system replacing manual, proxy-prone tracking, with a Java Android frontend and a Python/Flask backend. REST APIs handle real-time face detection, attendance marking, role-based access across student/teacher/admin roles, and Excel-based report exports. Patent filed.

featuredProjects.title: Legal Document Analyzer
featuredProjects.subtitle: LLM-Powered Document Intelligence
featuredProjects.description: AI platform that extracts, summarizes, and interprets legal documents using LLMs, reducing manual review effort on complex contracts and legal texts. Implements document ingestion, semantic search, and context-aware question answering via RAG.

featuredProjects.title: Hack2Hire
featuredProjects.subtitle: AI-Powered Mock Interview Platform
featuredProjects.description: Hackathon build simulating realistic technical interviews with AI-generated questions and instant feedback. Built in 24 hours at a hackathon — demonstrates rapid prototyping and full-stack integration with modern LLMs.

featuredProjects.title: Odysseus — Open Source
featuredProjects.subtitle: Confirmed Bugfix Contribution
featuredProjects.description: Diagnosed and fixed a NameError in routes/chat_routes.py in the Odysseus open-source project, submitted as a PR to the dev branch. Worked on Windows with uv tooling. Demonstrates ability to read unfamiliar codebases and contribute cleanly.
